stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(di):
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in di for x in r).most_common(1)[0][1]
    mk=[(i,j,di[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if di[i][j]!=bg]
    assert len(mk)==2,(mk,)
    a,b=mk
    pA=(a[0]+a[1])%2; pB=(b[0]+b[1])%2
    o=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):

            m,p=(a[2],pA) if dA<=dB else (b[2],pB)
            if (i+j)%2==p: o[i][j]=m
    return o

from collections import Counter
def solve(di):
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in di for x in r)
    mk=[(i,j,di[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if cnt[di[i][j]]==1]
    A,B=mk[0],mk[1]
    pA=(A[0]+A[1])%2; pB=(B[0]+B[1])%2
    o=[[di[0][0]]*W for _ in range(H)]  # use bg: find bg as mode excluding markers
    # bg = most common value overall
    bg=Counter(x for r in di for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    o=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):

import itertools,collections
def markers(di):
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in di for x in r)
    return [(i,j,di[i][j]) for i in range(len(di)) for j in range(len(di[0])) if cnt[di[i][j]]==1]
def solve(di):
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    ms=markers(di); A,B=ms
    bg=collections.Counter(x for r in di for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    o=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            dA,dB=abs(i-A[0])+abs(j-A[1]),abs(i-B[0])+abs(j-B[1])
            m=A if dA<=dB else B
            pm=(m[0]+m[1])%2
            if (i+j)%2==pm: o[i][j]=m[2]
    return o
print([solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in [1,2]])
out=solve(G['Test input']); json.dump(out,open('/tmp/out.json','w'))
